title: Tape encoded by zone contents
statement: Given zone contents with $\ell$ zones, define a tape on integer coordinates as follows. At coordinates $0$ and $1$, return respectively whether the home cell is present and its Boolean value, using false when it is absent. For $c\ge2$, let $n=c-2$; read the right-zone slot selected by $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$, encoding its presence at even $n$ and its Boolean value at odd $n$. For $c<0$, let $n=-c-1$; read the left-zone slot selected by $\lfloor n/2\rfloor$, encoding its Boolean value at even $n$ and its presence at odd $n$. In either zone, an unavailable slot gives no tape value.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $\ell$ and zone contents with $\ell$ zones
